checks: dormant: probes only, no veto while the notebook toolset is off
children: no repair or rollover veto, including depth-zero clones
journal state: freshness ordering, housekeeping, reset boundary, empty/rejected writes
gate: stale vetoes every attempt, bounded repair, overflow/idle guidance, live re-probe
marker: summary path waved through, notes-backed and absent markers veto, toolset-off untouched
receipts: read/failed/oversized writes, flush-failure rejection, navigation reset
quiet: no periodic injection across 50+/100+ ordinary turns
midpoint: 45 percent boundary, once per window, save/resume dedupe, reset, idle deferral and child isolation
hygiene: no journal writes, only bounded repair continuations
mutationsRejected: fails open instead of vetoing a stale rollover
ignores work after the notebook write
treats an empty notebook as saved
lets a repair rearm on every stale attempt
rearms a repair on an empty write
attaches the veto in child sessions
rejects a fresh notebook after a failed write that appended nothing
ignores the summary-path marker and vetoes every rollover
treats an absent marker as a summary-path compaction
